profile.headline: Software Engineer | Data Visualization & Analytics | React, TypeScript | Ex-Mailchimp
profile.summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with 8+ years building scalable, customer-facing web applications and analytics platforms for enterprise SaaS. I specialize in React, TypeScript, Angular, and GraphQL, and I turn complex data into intuitive, high-impact user experiences. I've led frontend initiatives end to end, mentored engineers, and partnered closely with product, design, and backend teams to ship features customers rely on.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned frontend for Email, SMS, and WhatsApp reporting serving 2.4M monthly users (React,
TypeScript, GraphQL).
• Led a 3-engineer frontend team in a cross-functional WhatsApp initiative, partnering with
product, design, and backend to move 5 reporting surfaces to GraphQL.
• Spearheaded SMS recipient reporting, streaming delivery and engagement metrics in near
real time and cutting latency from hours to minutes.
• Built the homepage Marketing Snapshot widget with a partner team on Intuit's App Fabric
micro-frontend platform, surfacing engagement and attributed revenue metrics.
• Migrated 3 Audience Analytics components to GraphQL and built their Playwright E2E suite.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · GraphQL · Data Visualization · Front-End Design

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · Web Development · TypeScript

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
• Collaborated with designer and product owner to update legacy portal for Fortune 100 insurance company using Angular, enhancing site aesthetics and functionality.
• Developed B2B e-commerce site with primary ownership of home page, product details, and checkout flow using React, Typescript, and Redux.
• Conducted bi-weekly technical demonstrations to stakeholders, delivering timely solutions for clients at CapTech Ventures, Inc.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Development · Node.js · React.js · TypeScript · Angular · React Native

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
• Updated and maintained all 3 of Buckle's customer facing portals built with React.js, Redux and Node.js
• Updated entire Onboarding Portal and Customer Account Portal with new branding and designs from Sketch utilizing CSS3 and SASS
• Utilized Axios Javascript library to integrate Payscape API for payment processing for use in Onboarding and Customer Account Portal applications
• Conducted code reviews for peers and participated in daily scrum meetings in an agile environment
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Development · React.js · JavaScript · TypeScript · User Interface Design

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained industry leading chat application built with Vue.js, Node.js, Yarn and Webpack
• Built reporting dashboard with reactive charts for web based chat platform utilizing Vue.js and D3.js charting library
 • Utilized WebSockets for establishing continuous communications between chat agent and customers
• Conducted code reviews for peers and participated in daily scrum meetings in an agile environment
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Node.js · D3.js · Vue.js · HTML5

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Fully responsible for maintenance, improvement and deployment of client facing Angular 7 web application with utilization of Typescript, Node.js, Webpack, Git and NPM
• Responsible for creating API hooks to 5 discrete microservices through RxJS
• Converted all pre-existing application pages to a responsive/adaptive mobile format utilizing flexbox and Angular fx-layout API
• Refactored entire admin section of application utilizing Angular Material for a cohesive look and feel
• Reconstructed Google analytics service to enable proper page and user behavior tracking
• Participated in complete reconfiguration of our backend stack for a serverless environment using AWS
• Worked closely with UI/UX designers and Product Owners to develop engaging, interactive experience while utilizing tools such as Invision and Sketch for prototyping
• Participated in daily scrum meetings with card/issue tracking through Jira
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Agile Development · React.js · Programming · Web Standards

projects.title: Picturesque
projects.description:
Photo sharing application that allows users to view, post, update and delete photos once logged in. The user can also comment on shared posts. I've employed Bootstrap 4 with material design elements on the front end in addition to Node.js/Express and MongoDB for the server and database respectively. 
Other technologies include: HTML5, CSS3, EJS(template engine), Passport and Mongoose.

projects.title: geoWiki
projects.description: Educational application utilizing the GeoIP API in order to return Wikipedia articles based on the users geographical location. This is a single page application which uses the following technologies: HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, JQuery, Bootstrap4, GeoIP API
